_comment: Audio manifest. All prompts are original wording describing mood and instrumentation only; no existing game, film, composer or track is named or imitated. Music: `npx tsx tools/gen-music.ts` writes public/audio/music/<id>.mp3 (idempotent: existing files are skipped). SFX: `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=... npx tsx tools/gen-audio.ts` writes public/audio/sfx/<id>.mp3 (idempotent; budget-capped). Prompts describe the mechanism, never a game or brand name.

items.prompt: Original instrumental score for a gritty industrial science-fiction war on a distant frontier colony world. No vocals, no choir, no singing. Title theme, about 90 BPM, minor key: opens with a lonely twangy baritone electric guitar with slide and spring reverb, like a frontier western at dusk, over a low organic pulsing bass that breathes like something alive underground; slowly builds with heavy industrial metal percussion, clanking machinery hits and distorted synth bass; cold shimmering ethereal synth pads float above; ends on a held dark chord. Cinematic, ominous, determined.

Original instrumental combat score for a gritty industrial science-fiction war on a frontier colony world. No vocals, no choir, no singing. Battle loop, steady 120 BPM, minor key, constant mid-high intensity from start to finish: driving gritty overdriven western-style electric guitar riff and palm-muted chugs, pounding industrial drums and metallic anvil hits, a low wet organic pulsing synth bass that throbs like a living swarm, and glassy ethereal synth pads and arpeggios shimmering on top. No intro build-up and no fade-out ending: starts and ends at the same energy so it loops seamlessly.

Original instrumental victory stinger for a gritty industrial science-fiction war game. No vocals, no choir. Short triumphant rising phrase: bold twangy western electric guitar and heavy industrial drum hits climbing to a big major resolution, bright shimmering synth pad swell, ending on one strong final chord and a decisive drum hit that rings out.

Original instrumental defeat stinger for a gritty industrial science-fiction war game. No vocals, no choir. Short somber falling phrase: a lonely detuned slide guitar descending in a minor key, a slow tolling metallic anvil, a low organic pulsing bass that slows down and dies away, cold dark synth drone fading to silence.

Single sharp supersonic rifle shot from a magnetic coil rifle: a crisp electric crack, a short metallic whip, then a brief ringing tail. Dry and close, no echo, no reloading. No music, no voices, no speech.
One heavy revolver gunshot: deep booming crack, a short ringing metal tail, then a quiet cylinder click. Dry outdoor air, no reloading. No music, no voices, no speech.

Short burst of five rapid automatic cannon rounds from a vehicle-mounted gun: deep thudding reports with a metallic rattle and a brief mechanical spin-down. No explosion. No music, no voices, no speech.
Salvo of four small rockets launched in quick succession: hissing ignition whoosh, rocket trails streaking away and fading into the distance. No impact explosion. No music, no voices, no speech.
One massive artillery cannon firing: a huge low boom with ground-shaking sub bass, a heavy metallic recoil clunk, and a long rumbling tail. No music, no voices, no speech.
Alien energy weapon firing a bolt: a rising crystalline charge chirp, then a sharp bright energy zap with a shimmering ringing tail, like a crackling lance of light. No music, no voices, no speech.

Rapid triple pulse from an alien particle blaster: three short bright humming energy bursts, each with a high crackle and quick decay, a faint electric buzz underneath. No music, no voices, no speech.
A glowing energy blade swung once: a hollow humming whoosh with a rising electric shimmer, ending in a bright crackling slash. No music, no voices, no speech.
A heavy crackling energy sword slash through the air: deep resonant hum, a sharp ringing cut, and a low pulse of warped space as it passes. No music, no voices, no speech.
A hard armoured gauntlet punch: a quick whoosh, then a dull heavy thud of metal on a body with a short servo whine. No music, no voices, no speech.
A knife-bayonet thrust: a quick whoosh, then a short dull stab into leather and padding with a faint metallic scrape. No music, no voices, no speech.
A giant armoured machine stomping down: a heavy hydraulic hiss, then a deep ground-shaking footfall with a crunch of gravel and metal. No music, no voices, no speech.
Sharp bony claws raking quickly twice: dry scraping slashes, a quick rasping hiss, a short fleshy impact. No roar. No music, no voices, no speech.
Two heavy curved bone blades cutting through the air in a fast cross slash: a whooshing swipe, then a sharp tearing cut. No roar. No music, no voices, no speech.
A volley of needle-sharp spines flicked through the air: rapid fine whistling hisses and quick thwips as they strike. No music, no voices, no speech.
A glob of caustic acid spat through the air: a wet gurgling spit, a hiss, then a sizzling fizz as it lands and corrodes metal. No music, no voices, no speech.
A pulse of living energy launched from an alien creature: a wet organic gulp and throb, a low warbling blast of crackling energy, and a squelching splash. No music, no voices, no speech.

A human soldier in heavy armour is killed: a short strained gasp over band-limited radio static, then a metallic body collapsing with armour plates clattering on hard ground. No music, no voices, no speech.
A small insect-like alien creature dies: a wet shrieking hiss and chitter dropping in pitch, a squelchy collapse, and a few twitching clicks fading out. No music, no voices, no speech.

An armoured alien warrior with an energy shield dies: a falling tone of failing shield energy, a bright crackling burst, then a glassy shimmering dissipation and a metal clang. No music, no voices, no speech.
Energy teleport arrival: a rising shimmering whine, a bright electric flash with a deep thump, and a ringing crystalline decay. No music, no voices, no speech.
A dropship releasing a unit: jet thrusters roaring down, a hydraulic clamp release hiss, then a heavy landing thud with metal clatter. No music, no voices, no speech.
A big creature bursting up through the ground: low rumbling earth, crumbling dirt and gravel, a wet tearing eruption, then dirt raining down. No music, no voices, no speech.
A tiny crisp mechanical button click on a sci-fi console: a single dry tick with a faint electronic blip. Very short. No music, no voices, no speech.
A soft electronic confirmation chirp: two quick rising tones, clean and subtle, like selecting an item on a holographic panel. No music, no voices, no speech.
A low calm two-note electronic alert tone with a soft metallic ping, signalling that it is your turn. No music, no voices, no speech.
Six wooden and plastic dice tumbling and rattling across a felt table and settling one by one. No music, no voices, no speech.
An energy shield absorbing a hit: a bright ringing zap with a glassy shimmer and crackle. Short. No music, no voices, no speech.
A heavy metal beacon planted on the ground: a solid clunk, a rising electronic activation hum, and a bright confirmation beep. No music, no voices, no speech.
